meaning: Check the fixed joint and omission interpretations in ExtendedControls. The direct three-being model satisfies the q3 premises and the direct esse-cause interface while rejecting the all-ordinary-causes interface, with both relations well-founded and all endpoints actual. Existing varying Ontic data are reused rather than replacing necessity or underivedness with flags. No metaphysical possibility or inclusion-minimality of the ten-premise theorem is claimed.
